selection.criteria: Fillout's provider-owned REST API reference publishes no artifact version marker; its preserved source surface has exactly the immutable 8-operation survey count.

connectors.evidence_source: metadata docs_url; provider-published Fillout REST API overview, expanded endpoint navigation, and Authentication section
connectors.counting_note: The provider's expanded REST API reference navigation enumerates eight callable actions: four GET retrievals (forms, form metadata, all submissions, and a submission by ID), one DELETE submission action, and three POST actions to create/remove webhooks and create submissions. GET actions are reads; the DELETE and all three POST actions mutate provider data/configuration and are writes. Webhook configuration operations are retained; no inbound webhook delivery type is counted.
connectors.selection_reason: official Fillout REST API reference exact-surface evidence fallback; provider publishes no artifact version marker
